_comment: Target universe. CIK is the SEC EDGAR identifier. fiscal_year_end is MM-DD of the registrant's fiscal year end (these are 52/53-week calendars for several names, so the exact day drifts year to year). 'history_note' flags data-availability caveats an analyst must know.

companies.name: Sandisk Corp
companies.history_note: Spun off from Western Digital in Feb 2025. Standalone SEC filings only exist from 2025 onward; earlier periods are inside Western Digital (CIK 106040) filings. Expect sparse multi-year history.

companies.name: Broadcom Inc.
companies.history_note: Current Broadcom Inc. holdco (post-2018 redomicile). FY ends late Oct/early Nov.

companies.name: Marvell Technology, Inc.
companies.history_note: Current Delaware holdco CIK (post-2021). FY ends late Jan/early Feb.

companies.name: Constellation Energy Corp
companies.history_note: Spun off from Exelon in Feb 2022. Standalone SEC filings only from 2022 onward.

companies.name: IREN Ltd
companies.history_note: Was a foreign private issuer (filed 20-F + 6-K); transitioned to U.S. domestic filer and now files 10-K/10-Q. The pipeline captures the RECENT 10-K/10-Q periods only; older years that exist solely in 20-F are not picked up. FY ends June 30.

companies.name: CoreWeave, Inc.
companies.history_note: IPO'd Mar 2025; expect sparse multi-year history.

companies.name: Nokia Corp
companies.history_note: Foreign private issuer (Finland). Files 20-F (annual) + 6-K, NOT 10-K/10-Q. The current extract.py collects only 10-K/10-Q, so it will yield ZERO XBRL facts until the pipeline is extended to 20-F.

companies.name: Lumentum Holdings Inc.
companies.history_note: 52/53-week fiscal calendar; FY ends late June/early July.

companies.name: Palantir Technologies Inc.
companies.history_note: Direct listing Sep 2020; multi-class share structure (Class A/B/F). Heavy ongoing insider Form 4 activity (Rule 10b5-1 plans).
